title: Tech Companies
tagline: Nepali companies with significant OSS footprints
description: Most Nepali tech companies are closed-source, but a few publish high-quality OSS: Khalti's payment SDKs, Leapfrog's libraries (nepali-date-picker), YoungInnovations' civic platforms, Yarsa's nepal-compliance ERPNext app, and Fusemachines' COVID work. Notably, F1Soft/eSewa has no prominent official GitHub org — a real ecosystem gap.

resources.name: tech-companies-in-nepal (mesaugat)
resources.description: Definitive index of Nepali tech ecosystem — 400+ companies, 343 stars. Airtable-backed JSON API.
